notes.title: ✅ Dev Update: Steam Cloud Implemented ✨
notes.content:
Just finished integrating Steam Cloud support for Endless Leveling in Mycelium Dungeons. When the game launches, your saves will sync across devices.

More updates coming soon. Feel free to wishlist if you want to follow the project's progress.

Also you can join to our discord to chat with devs btw - https://discord.gg/8xUvjrGayB

notes.title: Shocking behind-the-scenes from our dev team! 💻
notes.content:
So...

Today's dev diary:
[list]
[*] Programmer headbutted keyboard for 3 hours (finally fixed that bug)
[*] Artist added 27th shade of rotting mycelium (and it's glorious)
[*] Game designer rebalanced everything again (you'll love it... or hate it 😈)
[/list]

When you've got nothing to post but need to post something. It's not much but it's honest work.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45546280/ffedb013a35076321ff711c1a1e70526592687bd.jpg[/img]

P.S. Next close build coming soon - we'll have actual stuff to show!

Why did I even post this?))
